commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' The shots on goal statistics – 4:2.
90+4' Girona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
90+3' Iker Almena (Girona) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.

90+1' What a great effort! Nabil Fekir (Betis) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Gabriel Misehouy (Girona) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

88' Gabriel Misehouy (Girona) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Gabriel Misehouy (Girona) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Girona.
86' Having seen unsporting behavior, Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Aitor Ruibal (Betis) is the recipient.
86' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.

84' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Girona are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
83' Romain Perraud (Betis) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias's book.
83' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
81' Substitution. Cristhian Stuani (Girona) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Bryan Gil walks off.
81' Substitution. Ladislav Krejci (Girona) has come on for Abel Ruiz.
79' Betis seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
77' Manuel Pellegrini prepares a substitution. William Carvalho is replaced by Johnny Cardoso (Betis).
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sergi Altimira (Betis) will replace Marc Roca.
76' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
75' Betis are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
74' Chimy Avila (Betis) can't believe his eyes as he misses a big opportunity to convert a rebound. The ball brushes the left post.
73' 1 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Gabriel Misehouy (Girona) was set free in the area by Iker Almena and fired past Rui Silva. 1:1.
71' Here is a change. Yangel Herrera is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Gabriel Misehouy (Girona).
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Chimy Avila (Betis) for Aitor Ruibal.
70' 39:61 – the ratio of ball possession.
68' Girona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
66' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Iker Almena (Girona) replacing Portu.
66' Oriol Romeu will be replaced by Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona).
64' Nabil Fekir (Betis) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

63' Rodri (Betis) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes towards the roof of the net, but Paulo Gazzaniga keeps it out with an amazing save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Betis.
63' Wonderful movement by Girona. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
61' Abel Ruiz (Girona) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the right post. Unlucky! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
59' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) replaces Juanmi.
59' That will be all from Pablo Fornals who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Rodri (Betis).
59' Bryan Gil (Girona) receives a precise pass from his teammate and sends a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, his aim was a bit off and the ball flies just narrowly over the crossbar.
58' The Girona players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
57' Portu (Girona) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
56' Yangel Herrera (Girona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Girona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
56' Portu (Girona) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
55' Bryan Gil (Girona) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Now Girona have a corner.

55' Juanmi (Betis) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
54' Nabil Fekir (Betis) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
51' A great solo run by Bryan Gil (Girona) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort low towards the middle of the goal was easily caught by Rui Silva.
50' Portu (Girona) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
48' Girona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Betis keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Bryan Gil (Girona) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul.

44' Juanmi (Betis) latches onto a long cross into the centre of the box by Nabil Fekir but can't keep his header down, sending it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
44' Nabil Fekir (Betis) works the corner short.

42' Excellent touch by Romain Perraud (Betis)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
41' Oriol Romeu (Girona) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias signals.
40' Bryan Gil (Girona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

38' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) is in acres of space inside the box and lets fly with a shot which goes well wide of the right post. What a poor effort. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.

37' Girona slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
36' Abel Ruiz (Girona) commits a foul during an attacking move.
34' Girona are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
31' Great teamplay by Girona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
28' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
24' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
23' The Girona players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
21' Nabil Fekir (Betis) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
20' Paulo Gazzaniga pulls off a great save to deny Aitor Ruibal (Betis), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
19' Some great controlled play and passing from Betis. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

17' Yangel Herrera (Girona) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
16' Girona exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
12' The Girona players are exchanging some short passes.
8' Neat passing move from Betis in order to create new attacking opportunities.

6' 1 - 0 Marc Bartra (Betis) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the top left corner. The goalkeeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:0.
5' Corner kick. Nabil Fekir (Betis) is ready to send the ball into the box.

5' Romain Perraud (Betis) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender. Betis have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
4' Abel Ruiz (Girona) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
4' The Girona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' Betis control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' Oriol Romeu (Girona) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Betis will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias.
